# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| 2.0.x | yes |
| 1.x | no |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report it privately on GitHub:
**Security** tab → [**Report a vulnerability**](https://github.com/george7979/youtube-downloader/security/advisories/new).

Describe what is affected, how to reproduce it and what an attacker could do. You will get an
answer as soon as possible; once a fix is released, the advisory is published with credit to you
unless you prefer otherwise.

## Scope

In scope: this application, its installers and the way it downloads, verifies and runs its
tools (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, Deno) and writes notes. Problems in yt-dlp, ffmpeg or Deno themselves
belong to those projects.
